rule.label: square promotional image
rule.goal: adapt the existing promotional banner into a coherent 1:1 promotional image without redesigning the game visual
reference_rules: use an existing header banner as the preferred and authoritative mother image
if no header banner exists, use a real gameplay screenshot only as an upstream source for creating the header banner first
preserve the mother image's subject, camera direction, scene meaning, lighting, atmosphere, and main colors
content_constraints: the result must look like a natural square adaptation of the existing promotional image
prompt_rules: treat the reference banner as the only mother image
adapt the canvas through edge extension, local continuation, scaling, and minor movement of secondary edge content
keep the central subject and main narrative unchanged
keep existing title or logo content unchanged when retained
make the square composition balanced while keeping the original focal subject in the safe area
text_rules: do not rewrite or generate new title text, slogans, labels, or promotional copy
forbidden_elements: new composition, camera, subject, scene, props, effects, background, text, or decoration
new social-media poster layout or a newly designed concept image
UI, HUD, buttons, badges, or watermarks

manual_checks: the result must look like a natural square adaptation of the existing promotional image
next_steps: 图片仅保存在本地，CLI 未上传或修改资料字段。
请先确认候选图；确认后再执行候选项中的 upload_command 上传到素材库。
